name: dreamy-pink-boudoir-vintage-hollywood-coquette
image_purpose: vintage fashion lookbook and beauty editorial

prompt.project_info: Create a 3:4 vintage pink glamour portrait of one approved adult woman seated on a pink velvet sofa in a monochromatic Hollywood dressing-room set.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult woman with platinum-blonde hair set in large pink rollers, light blue eyes, natural pink-toned makeup, and soft dreamy expression. She wears a pink satin corset-style dress with sweetheart neckline and a pink sheer tulle robe with fluffy marabou trim, styled as tasteful vintage fashion with appropriate coverage.
composition_elements: Three-quarter seated portrait on a pink velvet sofa.
One hand gently touches the neck and collarbone; legs together in an elegant seated pose.
Pink satin curtains, velvet furniture, flowers, and decorative elements create an all-pink set.
Keep rollers, satin, tulle, feathers, and soft gaze clearly defined.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft diffused pink studio light, dreamy illumination, subtle shadows, romantic old-Hollywood dressing-room atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: Professional studio photography, 3:4 aspect ratio, front-facing slightly angled view, medium shot with upper body and legs visible, shallow depth of field, realistic satin, tulle, feather, and skin texture, no text or watermark.
